intro_fa: این قصه از گذشته گپ می‌زند: کار امروز نه، کار دیروز. مادرکلان یک شلغم بسیار کلان دارد که از زمین نمی‌براید. این قصه از روسیه آمده است.
say_en: The Big Turnip
show_en: The Big Turnip

say_en: Today she pulls. Yesterday she pulled.
say_fa: امروز کش می‌کند. دیروز کش کرد.
show_en: Today she pulls. Yesterday she pulled.

say_en: Today it is small. Yesterday it was small.
say_fa: امروز خُرد است. دیروز خُرد بود.
show_en: Today it is small. Yesterday it was small.

say_en: Last spring Grandmother planted a turnip seed in her garden. She watered it every day. The turnip was small in spring. It was big in summer. In autumn it was very, very big. It was as big as a sheep!
show_en: Last spring Grandmother planted a turnip seed in her garden. She watered it every day. The turnip was small in spring. It was big in summer. In autumn it was very, very big. It was as big as a sheep!

say_en: One morning Grandmother said: "Today I want turnip soup." She walked to the garden. She pulled the turnip. She pulled and pulled. But the turnip stayed in the ground. "It is too big for me," she said. She called Grandfather.
show_en: One morning Grandmother said: "Today I want turnip soup." She walked to the garden. She pulled the turnip. She pulled and pulled. But the turnip stayed in the ground. "It is too big for me," she said. She called Grandfather.

say_en: Who planted the turnip?
show_en: Who planted the turnip?
wrong_say_fa: نه. مادرکلان شلغم را کاشت. دوباره بخوان و جواب درست را انتخاب کن.

say_en: Grandfather pulled Grandmother. Grandmother pulled the turnip. They pulled and pulled. But the turnip stayed in the ground. Grandfather called Zarmina, their granddaughter. Zarmina pulled Grandfather. Grandfather pulled Grandmother. Grandmother pulled the turnip.
show_en: Grandfather pulled Grandmother. Grandmother pulled the turnip. They pulled and pulled. But the turnip stayed in the ground. Grandfather called Zarmina, their granddaughter. Zarmina pulled Grandfather. Grandfather pulled Grandmother. Grandmother pulled the turnip.

say_en: They pulled and pulled. But the turnip stayed in the ground! Zarmina called the dog. The dog pulled Zarmina. Zarmina pulled Grandfather. Grandfather pulled Grandmother. Grandmother pulled the turnip. And the turnip? It stayed in the ground.
show_en: They pulled and pulled. But the turnip stayed in the ground! Zarmina called the dog. The dog pulled Zarmina. Zarmina pulled Grandfather. Grandfather pulled Grandmother. Grandmother pulled the turnip. And the turnip? It stayed in the ground.

say_en: The dog called the cat. The cat pulled the dog, the dog pulled Zarmina, Zarmina pulled Grandfather, Grandfather pulled Grandmother, and Grandmother pulled the turnip. They pulled and pulled. The turnip moved a little... but it stayed in the ground.
show_en: The dog called the cat. The cat pulled the dog, the dog pulled Zarmina, Zarmina pulled Grandfather, Grandfather pulled Grandmother, and Grandmother pulled the turnip. They pulled and pulled. The turnip moved a little... but it stayed in the ground.

say_en: They pulled and pulled.
show_en: They pulled and pulled.

say_en: Why did the turnip stay in the ground?
show_en: Why did the turnip stay in the ground?
wrong_say_fa: نه. شلغم بسیار کلان بود، پس از زمین نبرامد. دوباره بخوان و جواب درست را انتخاب کن.

say_en: Then a small mouse walked by. "Can I help?" asked the mouse. The cat laughed. "You? You are too small!" "Let her help," said Grandmother. So the mouse pulled the cat, and everyone pulled together. One, two, three...
show_en: Then a small mouse walked by. "Can I help?" asked the mouse. The cat laughed. "You? You are too small!" "Let her help," said Grandmother. So the mouse pulled the cat, and everyone pulled together. One, two, three...

say_en: POP! The turnip jumped out of the ground! Everybody was on the ground too: Grandmother, Grandfather, Zarmina, the dog, the cat and the mouse. They laughed and laughed. That evening Grandmother cooked a big pot of turnip soup, and there was a plate for the mouse too.
show_en: POP! The turnip jumped out of the ground! Everybody was on the ground too: Grandmother, Grandfather, Zarmina, the dog, the cat and the mouse. They laughed and laughed. That evening Grandmother cooked a big pot of turnip soup, and there was a plate for the mouse too.

say_en: Who helped last?
say_fa: آخر از همه کی کمک کرد؟
show_en: Who helped last?
wrong_say_fa: نه. آخر از همه موش خُرد کمک کرد، و شلغم برامد. دوباره بخوان و جواب درست را انتخاب کن.

intro_fa: باد و آفتاب با هم مسابقه کردند: کدام یک زورآورتر است؟ این قصه بسیار کهنه از گذشته گپ می‌زند.
say_en: The Wind and the Sun
show_en: The Wind and the Sun

say_en: Today I go. Yesterday I went.
show_en: Today I go. Yesterday I went.

say_en: Today I see. Yesterday I saw.
show_en: Today I see. Yesterday I saw.

say_en: One day the wind and the sun looked down at the world. "I am stronger than you," said the wind. "I can push trees down. I can move the clouds." The sun smiled. "You are strong," she said, "but strong is not everything."
show_en: One day the wind and the sun looked down at the world. "I am stronger than you," said the wind. "I can push trees down. I can move the clouds." The sun smiled. "You are strong," she said, "but strong is not everything."

say_en: Then they saw a girl on the road. Her name was Parwin. She went to school every morning in a big brown coat. "Look at that girl," said the wind. "Who can take off her coat? You or I? Then we know who is stronger." "Good," said the sun. "You first."
show_en: Then they saw a girl on the road. Her name was Parwin. She went to school every morning in a big brown coat. "Look at that girl," said the wind. "Who can take off her coat? You or I? Then we know who is stronger." "Good," said the sun. "You first."

say_en: The sun went behind a cloud. The wind started. First it was a small wind. The leaves moved. Then it was a big wind. Whoo! Dust was in the air. Parwin's scarf moved up and down. Her coat opened a little.
show_en: The sun went behind a cloud. The wind started. First it was a small wind. The leaves moved. Then it was a big wind. Whoo! Dust was in the air. Parwin's scarf moved up and down. Her coat opened a little.

say_en: What did the wind want to take off?
say_fa: باد می‌خواست چه را از تن پروین بکشد؟
show_en: What did the wind want to take off?
wrong_say_fa: نه. باد می‌خواست بالاپوش پروین را بکشد. دوباره بخوان و جواب درست را انتخاب کن.

say_en: But Parwin was cold. She closed her coat. The wind pushed harder. WHOOO! The trees moved from side to side. Parwin closed every button. She put her arms around her coat and walked on. The wind pushed and pushed. Then it was tired, and it stopped.
show_en: But Parwin was cold. She closed her coat. The wind pushed harder. WHOOO! The trees moved from side to side. Parwin closed every button. She put her arms around her coat and walked on. The wind pushed and pushed. Then it was tired, and it stopped.

say_en: Why did Parwin close her coat?
say_fa: چرا پروین بالاپوش خود را بسته کرد؟
show_en: Why did Parwin close her coat?
choices: t:it was new|t:she was cold|t:she was hot
wrong_say_fa: نه. باد سرد بود و پروین خنک خورد، پس بالاپوش خود را بسته کرد. دوباره بخوان و جواب درست را انتخاب کن.

say_en: "Now it is my turn," said the sun. She came out from behind the cloud. She did not push. She did not make any noise. She only smiled, warm and yellow. The birds started to sing. The road was dry again.
show_en: "Now it is my turn," said the sun. She came out from behind the cloud. She did not push. She did not make any noise. She only smiled, warm and yellow. The birds started to sing. The road was dry again.

say_en: The sun came out.
show_en: The sun came out.

say_en: Parwin looked up. "What a good day!" she said. She opened one button. The sun smiled a little more. Parwin opened all the buttons. Soon she was very warm. She stopped under a tree, and the coat came off. She put it in her bag.
show_en: Parwin looked up. "What a good day!" she said. She opened one button. The sun smiled a little more. Parwin opened all the buttons. Soon she was very warm. She stopped under a tree, and the coat came off. She put it in her bag.

say_en: The wind looked at the sun. "You were right," it said. "I pushed hard, and she closed her coat. You were warm and kind, and she opened it." "Yes," said the sun. "A kind word opens more doors than a hard push."
show_en: The wind looked at the sun. "You were right," it said. "I pushed hard, and she closed her coat. You were warm and kind, and she opened it." "Yes," said the sun. "A kind word opens more doors than a hard push."

say_en: Who made Parwin take off her coat?
say_fa: از دست کی پروین بالاپوش خود را کشید؟
show_en: Who made Parwin take off her coat?
wrong_say_fa: نه. آفتاب گرم بود، پس پروین خودش بالاپوش را کشید. دوباره بخوان و جواب درست را انتخاب کن.

round: # 03: Two Goats on the Bridge (folk fable)

intro_fa: دو بز روی یک پل بسیار تنگ با هم روبرو شدند. هیچ کدام نمی‌خواست پس برود. بعد چه شد؟ این قصه کهنه از گذشته گپ می‌زند.
say_en: Two Goats on the Bridge
show_en: Two Goats on the Bridge

say_en: Today he says no. Yesterday he said no.
say_fa: امروز نه می‌گوید. دیروز نه گفت.
show_en: Today he says no. Yesterday he said no.

say_en: Today she comes. Yesterday she came.
show_en: Today she comes. Yesterday she came.

say_en: There was a river in the mountains. The water was fast and cold. Over the river there was a bridge. It was only one long tree, and it was very narrow. There was room for one animal, but not for two.
show_en: There was a river in the mountains. The water was fast and cold. Over the river there was a bridge. It was only one long tree, and it was very narrow. There was room for one animal, but not for two.

say_en: One morning a white goat came to the bridge from the left. The grass on the right side was green, and she wanted it. At the same time a black goat came from the right. He wanted the green leaves on the left side.
show_en: One morning a white goat came to the bridge from the left. The grass on the right side was green, and she wanted it. At the same time a black goat came from the right. He wanted the green leaves on the left side.

say_en: The two goats walked onto the bridge. In the middle they stopped. They looked at each other. "Go back," said the white goat. "I was here first." "No, you go back," said the black goat. "I am bigger."
show_en: The two goats walked onto the bridge. In the middle they stopped. They looked at each other. "Go back," said the white goat. "I was here first." "No, you go back," said the black goat. "I am bigger."

say_en: The two goats stopped in the middle of the bridge.
show_en: The two goats stopped in the middle of the bridge.

say_en: Where did the two goats stop?
say_fa: دو بز در کجا ایستاد شدند؟
show_en: Where did the two goats stop?
wrong_say_fa: نه. دو بز در میان پل ایستاد شدند. دوباره بخوان و جواب درست را انتخاب کن.

say_en: "I never go back!" said the white goat. "And I never go back!" said the black goat. They put their heads down. They pushed. Crack! The bridge moved. Small stones dropped into the fast, cold water far below.
show_en: "I never go back!" said the white goat. "And I never go back!" said the black goat. They put their heads down. They pushed. Crack! The bridge moved. Small stones dropped into the fast, cold water far below.

say_en: The goats stopped and looked down. The river was loud and white. Their legs were not so strong now. "If we push, we both fall into the water," said the white goat slowly. "Yes," said the black goat. "And then nobody eats grass today."
show_en: The goats stopped and looked down. The river was loud and white. Their legs were not so strong now. "If we push, we both fall into the water," said the white goat slowly. "Yes," said the black goat. "And then nobody eats grass today."

say_en: Why did the goats stop pushing?
say_fa: چرا بزها دیگر یکدیگر را تیله نکردند؟
show_en: Why did the goats stop pushing?
wrong_say_fa: نه. آن‌ها دیدند که اگر یکدیگر را تیله کنند، هر دو در دریا می‌افتند. دوباره بخوان و جواب درست را انتخاب کن.

say_en: They were quiet. Then the black goat had an idea. "I can lie down," he said. "Then you can walk over my back. It is not easy, but it is better than the river." He went down on his knees, very slowly, and put his head on the tree.
show_en: They were quiet. Then the black goat had an idea. "I can lie down," he said. "Then you can walk over my back. It is not easy, but it is better than the river." He went down on his knees, very slowly, and put his head on the tree.

say_en: The white goat walked over him, one small step after another. Then the black goat was on his feet again, and he walked on. Now the white goat was on the right side and the black goat was on the left. "Thank you!" called the white goat. "Enjoy your grass!" called the black goat.
show_en: The white goat walked over him, one small step after another. Then the black goat was on his feet again, and he walked on. Now the white goat was on the right side and the black goat was on the left. "Thank you!" called the white goat. "Enjoy your grass!" called the black goat.

say_en: Who had the good idea?
show_en: Who had the good idea?
wrong_say_fa: نه. بز سیاه گفت: من دراز می‌کشم و تو از پشت من تیر شو. دوباره بخوان و جواب درست را انتخاب کن.
